label: confirmatory-end-to-end-matched-before-training
question: Does the full RBEE-256 plus SetPO-64 pipeline yield a seed-robust improvement over official SpotSound-A?
causal_rationale: E001 used unequal parent quality. Repeating the complete seed-0 pipeline isolates seed variance from parent under-training and supplies a fair RBEE ablation.

pipeline.rbee: Official SpotSound-A parent; 256 steps; lr=5e-6; 512 cached relation groups; method_weight=1.0; rehearsal_weight=0.5; seed in {0,1,2}.
pipeline.setpo: Matched RBEE parent; 64 steps over the same 512 available relation groups with a four-group memory cache; lr=2e-6; method_weight=0.5; exchange_weight=1.0; rehearsal_weight=0.5 every 4 steps; target_temperature=0.15; jitter_ratio=0.15; same seed as parent.

development_dataset: RelTwin-ESC50 v1 train/test split; method selection and gate use only its held-out test set.
public_dataset: SpotSound-Bench revision 2e64ad197b90d6bd3b43efc73738cb9f86810735, all 400 annotation rows and 387 unique audio files.
baseline: Official SpotSound-A adapter evaluated by the identical frozen 400-row harness.
checkpoint_policy: Final checkpoint at the fixed step count; no checkpoint or seed selection.
development_gate: Before public evaluation, both new seeds must improve their matched RBEE parent on held-out RelTwin query mIoU and pair_acc_0.5; the three-seed SetPO mean must exceed the three-seed RBEE mean on both metrics.
public_success_criterion: All three SetPO seeds exceed the same-harness official baseline in SpotSound mIoU, and the paired hierarchical seed-record bootstrap 95% CI of the three-seed mean delta excludes zero.
failure_criterion: The development gate fails, any public seed regresses, or the public mIoU confidence interval includes zero.
stop_criterion: No hyperparameter changes may use E002 SpotSound results. A later method must be selected using a separate development protocol and evaluated once.
timing_note: Locked after E001 exposed the parent mismatch and before training either matched seed 1 or seed 2. Existing seed-0 stage results are retained; no seed-1/2 matched result was available. A first seed-1 attempt was stopped at RBEE step 92/256 with no checkpoint after an operational cache mismatch was found; the corrected run restarts from step zero and the aborted trace is excluded.
